rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that feels unpleasant or uncomfortable, especially a situation, sensation, or experience.

example.english: The smell of this perfume is unpleasant.
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 hoeng1 seoi2 man4 lok6 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this when the unpleasantness is chiefly physical or emotional suffering rather than merely irritating.

example.english: My stomach hurts so badly that it feels unpleasant.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 wai6 tung3 dou3 hou2 naan4 sau6

rows.note: Use this for an unpleasant person, behaviour, or thing that you dislike or find annoying.

example.english: I find it really unpleasant when he talks like that.
example.traditional: 我真係好討厭佢咁樣講嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 tou2 jim3 keoi5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 je5

rows.note: Use this for an unpleasant event, interaction, or experience when a more formal or measured tone is appropriate.

example.english: The atmosphere at this meeting was unpleasant.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 wui6 min6 hei3 fan1 m4 jyu4 faai3
